data.name: Khaled
data.gender_notes: Khaled is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'K-H-D', meaning 'most excellent' or 'most generous'. In Islamic history, Khaled bin Al-Walid was a renowned military leader who converted to Islam and played a significant role in the early Islamic conquests. The name Khaled carries the meaning “Eternal” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khaled usually hope their child will grow to embody eternal and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of strength, courage, and loyalty.
data.etymology: Khaled belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Eternal.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khaled total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: خالد
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مذكر يعني الخلد والبقاء
in_arabic.long_meaning: خالد هو اسم علم مذكر يعود إلى الجذر العربي خ ل د، الذي يعني البقاء والخلد، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في التاريخ الإسلامي لعدد من الشخصيات المهمة، ومنهم خالد بن الوليد الصحابي الجليل، ويتسمى به اليوم العديد من الأشخاص في العالم الإسلامي، وله دلالة روحية عمیقة على الاستمرار والدوام

in_urdu.name: خالد
in_urdu.meaning: خالد کا مطلب ہے باقی رہنے والا اور لمبا زندگی گزارنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: خالد ایک عربی نام ہے جو خ ل د کے جڑ سے لیا گیا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے باقی رہنا اور لمبا زندگی گزارنا، اس نام کا استعمال اسلامی تاریخ میں بہت سے اہم شخصیات کے لیے کیا گیا ہے، جن میں خالد بن الولید شامل ہیں، اور آج بھی مسلم دنیا میں بہت سے لوگ اس نام سے منسوب ہیں، اس نام کی روحانی اہمیت بھی ہے جو استمرار اور دوام کی علامت ہے

in_hindi.name: खालिद
in_hindi.meaning: खालिद का अर्थ है लंबी आयु वाला और अमर
in_hindi.long_meaning: खालिद एक अरबी नाम है जो ख ल द के मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है लंबी आयु वाला और अमर, इस नाम का इस्तेमाल इस्लामी इतिहास में कई महत्वपूर्ण व्यक्तियों के लिए किया गया है, जिनमें खालिद बिन वलीद शामिल हैं, और आज भी मुस्लिम दुनिया में कई लोग इस नाम से जुड़े हुए हैं, इस नाम का धार्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व भी है जो जीवन की लंबाई और अमरता का प्रतीक है

in_pashto.name: خالد
in_pashto.meaning: خالد د nghĩa له پاتې کېدل او اوږد ژوند کول

data.cultural_impact: Khaled is a name associated with bravery, leadership, and military prowess in Islamic culture. The name carries the legacy of Khaled bin Al-Walid, a legendary figure who successfully led the Muslim army against the Byzantine and Sassanid forces despite being vastly outnumbered. Khaled's military exploits laid the foundation for the Islamic Caliphate's expansion and consolidation of power.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, the name Khaled symbolizes the highest ideals of inspiration, self-sacrifice, and nobility. Every individual named Khaled is believed to carry these virtues within their being, representing an embodiment of generous hospitality and fine moral character. This spiritual significance reflects the strategic mindset and strong moral compass that guided Khaled bin Al-Walid during his military campaigns, positioning him as an inspiration and triumphant hero in Islamic history.

historical_references.reference: Khalid ibn al-Walid (592-642 AD): A renowned warrior and poet known as the 'Sword of Allah'. He led the Muslim armies to victory in many battles during the early Islamic expansion, including the Battle of Uhud and the Battle of Khaybar. Khalid's military strategies, courage, and leadership became a model for Muslims.

Khalid bin Yazid (603-660 AD): A powerful and influential figure in the Umayyad Caliphate, Khalid served as the governor of Kufa and later became the governor of Egypt. He was known for his wealth and lavish lifestyle, and is believed to have commissioned the construction of the Al-Azhar Mosque in Cairo.
